faqs.question: What is the difference between the Osmo Nano Camera Unit and the Vision Dock?
faqs.answer: The Osmo Nano camera unit is an ultra-lightweight 52g modular camera capable of recording 4K/60fps video and waterproof up to 10 meters standalone. The Multifunctional Vision Dock adds an OLED touchscreen for framing and menu control, extended battery life up to 200 minutes, fast charging, and wireless detached preview.

faqs.question: Is the Osmo Nano camera completely waterproof without a dive case?
faqs.answer: Yes! The Osmo Nano camera module is waterproof down to 10 meters (33 feet) natively. However, the Multifunctional Vision Dock is IPX4 splash-resistant and should not be submerged underwater without a waterproof housing.

faqs.question: Can I connect the DJI Mic 2 directly to Osmo Nano without a receiver?
faqs.answer: Yes. With DJI's proprietary OsmoAudio™ technology, the Osmo Nano camera connects directly to up to two DJI Mic 2 transmitters via Bluetooth without requiring the external RX receiver plugged into the USB port.

faqs.question: How do I mount the Osmo Nano to my clothing or hats?
faqs.answer: The Osmo Nano includes both a Magnetic Lanyard (worn under clothing while the camera attaches magnetically through the fabric) and a Magnetic Hat Clip that slides onto cap brims and visors for first-person POV angles.

faqs.question: Does Osmo Nano have internal storage or do I need a microSD card?
faqs.answer: Osmo Nano features built-in high-speed internal storage (64GB or 128GB depending on your chosen combo). The Multifunctional Vision Dock also features a microSD card slot supporting up to 1TB expansion.

faqs.question: What warranty and service comes with Osmo Nano purchased from D1 Store?
faqs.answer: Every Osmo Nano sold by D1 Store includes a 100% genuine Australian 2-Year Warranty, local Melbourne and Sydney service centers, and eligibility for official DJI Care Refresh 1-Year or 2-Year replacement plans.

features: 1-Inch High-Dynamic CMOS Sensor with 14 Stops of Dynamic Range
2.0-inch Rotatable OLED Touchscreen (1000 nits Peak Brightness)
Direct Pairing with Dual DJI Mic 2 & Mic 3 Transmitters

faqs.question: What are the major upgrades on Osmo Pocket 4 compared to Osmo Pocket 3?
faqs.answer: Osmo Pocket 4 introduces an all-new 1-inch CMOS sensor with up to 4K/240fps slow-motion recording, an expanded 14-stop dynamic range, 107 GB of ultra-fast built-in solid-state storage, upgraded ActiveTrack 7.0 with dual-person follow, USB 3.1 wired offload speeds up to 800 MB/s, and a brighter 2-inch OLED touchscreen with 1000 nits peak brightness for effortless daylight viewing.

faqs.question: What is the difference between the Standard Combo and Creator Combo?
faqs.answer: The Standard Combo includes the Osmo Pocket 4, Protective Cover, Wrist Strap, Handle with 1/4" Thread, and USB-C Cable. The Creator Combo includes everything in the standard package PLUS the DJI Mic 2 Wireless Transmitter (with clip magnet and furry windshield), Osmo Pocket 4 Battery Handle (giving +62% runtime), Osmo Mini Tripod, Magnetic Wide-Angle Lens, and a dedicated zippered Carrying Bag. Purchasing the Creator Combo saves over $245 AUD compared to buying accessories individually.

faqs.question: Is the Osmo Pocket 4 waterproof or weather-resistant?
faqs.answer: No, Osmo Pocket 4 is a precision mechanical gimbal device and is not waterproof. Do not expose it to rain, snow, or submersion. If you plan to shoot underwater or around heavy water sports, use an official DJI Waterproof Case (waterproof to 60 meters) or consider the DJI Osmo Action series.

faqs.question: Can I use Osmo Pocket 4 as a 4K webcam or livestreaming camera?
faqs.answer: Yes! Osmo Pocket 4 features plug-and-play UVC/UAC USB webcam support. Simply connect it to your Mac or PC via the included USB-C cable to broadcast in crystal-clear 4K or 1080p for Zoom, Microsoft Teams, and OBS. For mobile livestreaming, connect to the DJI Mimo app and stream directly to YouTube, Twitch, or Facebook via RTMP.

faqs.question: How does the 1-inch CMOS sensor perform in low-light and night scenes?
faqs.answer: The large 1-inch sensor features significantly larger individual pixels that absorb far more ambient light than conventional smartphone sensors. Combined with an f/2.0 aperture and dedicated Low-Light Video mode (ISO up to 32,000 with hardware noise reduction), Osmo Pocket 4 produces vivid, noise-suppressed nighttime cityscapes, campfire moments, and indoor concerts with rich color preservation.

faqs.question: What slow-motion frame rates and video resolutions are supported?
faqs.answer: In 4K UHD (3840×2160), Pocket 4 shoots at 24, 25, 30, 48, 50, 60, 120, and up to a groundbreaking 240 fps. In 2.7K and 1080p Full HD, it also supports smooth 240 fps capture for breathtaking 8x slow-motion playback at 30 fps, capturing rapid action, sports, water droplets, and stunts in extreme clarity.

faqs.question: What is 10-bit D-Log M and 10-bit HLG HDR?
faqs.answer: Standard 8-bit video records approximately 16.7 million colors, whereas 10-bit color records over 1.07 billion colors. D-Log M retains higher dynamic range and preserves subtle tonal gradients in skies and skin tones, giving filmmakers maximum color grading freedom in Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, or Final Cut Pro. 10-bit HLG allows instant HDR playback on compatible HDR TVs and OLED displays without grading.

faqs.question: Can I shoot vertical video natively for TikTok, YouTube Shorts, and Instagram Reels?
faqs.answer: Yes! Simply rotate the 2.0-inch OLED touchscreen 90 degrees into vertical orientation, and the camera sensor switches automatically into 3K native vertical mode (3072×1728 at up to 60 fps). This eliminates the need to crop horizontal 4K video or lose quality in editing apps.

faqs.question: How does 3-axis mechanical gimbal stabilization compare to smartphone electronic EIS?
faqs.answer: Electronic Image Stabilization (EIS) works by digitally cropping into your image frame and warping pixel edges, which degrades resolution, introduces micro-jitter in low light, and causes motion blur distortion. Osmo Pocket 4 uses real three-axis brushless motors that physically tilt, pan, and roll the camera lens in real time to counteract hand movement, delivering full uncropped 4K resolution and cinematic camera sweeps.

faqs.question: How does ActiveTrack 7.0 work when vlogging or moving around?
faqs.answer: ActiveTrack 7.0 uses advanced computer vision deep learning to identify humans, faces, and pets. Once selected by tapping on the touchscreen, the gimbal motors physically rotate to follow the subject everywhere they move. It automatically re-acquires subjects if they briefly turn around or walk behind obstacles.

faqs.question: Can Osmo Pocket 4 connect directly to DJI Mic transmitters without a receiver?
faqs.answer: Yes! Osmo Pocket 4 has integrated Wi-Fi and Bluetooth wireless receiver modules directly inside the body. It pairs wirelessly with up to two DJI Mic 2 or DJI Mic 3 transmitters without needing a receiver plugged into the USB port, keeping the gimbal lightweight and fully accessible.

faqs.question: How does the built-in 3-microphone array perform in windy conditions?
faqs.answer: Pocket 4 incorporates three studio-grade omnidirectional microphones situated on the front, back, and side of the device. Intelligent directional audio zoom focuses on the speaker's voice in front of the lens while suppressing background ambient noise and wind buffeting.

faqs.question: How long does the battery last on a single charge and how fast does it recharge?
faqs.answer: The internal 1545 mAh battery provides up to 166 minutes of operating time at 1080p/24fps. With the Creator Combo's Battery Handle attached, operating time extends to 270 minutes (over 4.5 hours). Using a 65W PD fast charger, Pocket 4 charges to 80% in just 16 minutes and reaches 100% in 32 minutes.

faqs.question: Can I record while charging from a portable power bank?
faqs.answer: Yes! Osmo Pocket 4 fully supports continuous recording while connected to an external USB-C PD power bank or wall adapter, making it ideal for multi-hour timelapse videos, conference recordings, and all-day wedding shoots.

faqs.question: Are Osmo Pocket 3 accessories compatible with Osmo Pocket 4?
faqs.answer: Most magnetic optical accessories (such as Black Mist filters, ND filters, and wide-angle lenses) and DJI Mic 2 transmitters are cross-compatible. However, because Pocket 4 features an updated ergonomic grip and enhanced thermal dissipation ports, protective cases and battery handles are specifically tailored for Pocket 4.

faqs.question: What Australian warranty and support is included when buying from D1 Store?
faqs.answer: As an Authorised DJI Retailer in Australia, every purchase comes with an official 2-Year Australian Manufacturer Warranty, free express insured shipping on orders over $99, 14-day replacement support, and access to D1 Store retail locations across Australia for in-person support, repair, and trade-ins.
